the move already routes stack through the helpers' behavior: down and cleanup sweep by label or compose project (B38, preserve), stack's lease and held_port check UDP as well as TCP (part of B36, preserve), and the moved code's event kinds are PORTS.PORT.HELD, PORTS.IPV6.ABSENT, SWEEP.DOCKER.UNREACHED, SWEEP.REMOVAL.REFUSED, GROUP.MEMBERS.GONE (B41, rewrite); stack still mints its tag with os.urandom and keeps its own stack.json lease and holder until the stack-rebuild stage
